text: Standing outside the glass-walled room, I feel a sense of anticipation and distance, as if I am glimpsing the preparations for some intellectual endeavor. Moving closer to the vibrant R+D wall, I am curious and invigorated. The celebration of research and progress fills me with wonder about the ways our collective knowledge constantly evolves. Here, between the sterile meeting room and the energetic exhibit, I feel poised on the threshold of discovery and creation.
